whatIs: Colorsss is a color explorer you filter by tone and shade: neutral, pastel, muted, dark, warm, vibrant and others. Each color appears with its name and its HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH codes, and more are generated as you scroll.
It's a good fit when you don't know which color you want and would rather browse options by style before deciding.
uses: Finding a pastel tone for a landing page background.
Choosing vibrant colors for a chart or an illustration.
Finding neutral and muted tones for a sober interface.
caveats: It's for exploring and copying individual values; it doesn't build exportable palettes or check contrast.
The page shows a promotional bar for another product by its authors.
pricingNote: Free to use from the browser.
idealFor: Exploring colors by tone when you're looking for inspiration.
